text.en: This Order m ay be cited as the Misuse of Drugs Act (Amendment) Ordert 2002 · Amendment of Second Schedule to Chapter 27 ·

The Second Schedule to the Misuse of Drugs Act is amended 间 (b ) 63 by deleting, against section 3 in the first column, the item in the second column relating to "Unauthorised traffic in methylamphetamine" and by substituting the following item therefor " Unauthori sed traffic in methylamphetamine, where the quantity is ( 可 not less than 20 grammes and not more than 50 grammes (b ) more than 50 grammes" ; by deleting, against section 3A in the first column, the item in the second column relating to "Unauthorised possession of controlled drugs fo r the purpose of trafficking therein, containing such quantity of methylamphetamine" and by substituting the following item therefor "Unauthorised possession of controlled drugs for the purpose of trafficking therein , containing such quantity of methylamphetamine being ( 可 not less than 40 grammes and not more than loo grammes (b ) more than loo grammes" ; by deleting, against section 5 in the first column , the item in the second column relating to "Unauthorised import or export Of methylamphetamine " and by substituting the following item therefor
